name: Doubt-Driven Development
mechanism: For in-scope non-trivial decisions, isolates artifact and contract, invokes an adversarial fresh-context reviewer, reconciles findings against the artifact, and stops on bounded conditions.
limitationOrConflict: Local design and implementation reviews use fresh independent Review Sidekicks with source/plan/rail admission and sequential proof checks; they are separate review workflows, not an automatic per-decision Claim–Extract–Doubt–Reconcile–Stop loop. Addy's skill is not required for every task and excludes trivial/mechanical work.

name: Incremental Implementation
mechanism: Implements thin slices with test, verification, and a commit before proceeding, preferring vertical and risk-first slices and scope discipline.
limitationOrConflict: Local implementation executes an immutable authorized plan and its proof gates, but does not require a commit after each slice. Addy's incomplete-feature flags, rollback approach, and compatibility practices cannot override the owner-supplied no-gradual-compatibility instruction or plan boundary.

name: Frontend UI Engineering
mechanism: Provides component structure, UI state, design-system adherence, responsive layout, accessibility, and rendered verification guidance.
limitationOrConflict: The inspected local workflow homes specify observable UI behavior and structural contracts or test macOS UI, but no current skill owns frontend implementation craft, CSS/component conventions, or accessibility checks end to end.

name: Test-Driven Development
mechanism: Uses RED–GREEN–REFACTOR, requires a failing reproduction for behavior bugs, and advises a test pyramid of roughly 80% unit, 15% integration, and 5% end-to-end tests.
limitationOrConflict: The local implementation plan uses red/green when required and selects fitting proof from the accepted plan; local debugging seeks a durable failing reproduction when it fits. No fixed 80/15/5 ratio appears in these local skills. Keep TDD scoped to behavioral changes; Addy's own NOT-use clause excludes cosmetic/config/docs changes without behavioral effect.

name: Browser Testing with DevTools
mechanism: Exercises browser behavior through Chrome DevTools MCP: reproduce, inspect DOM/console/network, diagnose, fix, then verify with screenshots and runtime signals.
limitationOrConflict: Peekaboo covers native macOS UI interaction and implementation review is read-only; neither supplies the same Chrome DevTools browser, console, network, screenshot, and accessibility-tree workflow.

name: Debugging and Error Recovery
mechanism: Stops feature work, preserves failure evidence, reproduces/localizes/reduces the issue, fixes root cause, adds a regression guard, and verifies the full scenario.
limitationOrConflict: The local debug skill covers the diagnosis-first root-cause loop and adds read-only investigation, ranked hypotheses, bounded agents, deterministic monitoring, and an artifact. Its fix and proof phase is owned separately by the plan executor; the legacy source's sleep/artificial-delay suggestion is not local proof authority.

name: Code Review and Quality
mechanism: Reviews correctness, readability/simplicity, architecture, security, and performance; orders and categorizes findings and checks the verification story.
limitationOrConflict: Local implementation review is anchored to confirmed obligations, an immutable plan, whole-file diff coverage, proof challenge, and findings reduction; design review is a separate phase. It does not substitute a generic five-axis checklist or authorize review findings without a governing rail.

name: Code Simplification
mechanism: Requires understanding callers, tests, edge cases, and possible historical reasons before a behavior-preserving incremental simplification; specifically asks the reader to check git blame for original context.
limitationOrConflict: The source does not prescribe proving why a specific guard exists by tracing blame, all history, and tests. Local Program Design checks accepted-requirement coverage after deleting/simplifying mechanisms, but there is no dedicated local simplification workflow or blame-history requirement.

name: Security and Hardening
mechanism: Maps trust boundaries and assets, writes abuse cases, then applies boundary validation, access-control, secrets, dependency, privacy, SSRF, and LLM hardening checks.
limitationOrConflict: Local Program Design models trust boundaries and observability/security obligations; ops-security-review routes explicit scans to official Codex Security workflows. The local security skill is an audit handoff, not this general implementation-hardening handbook.

name: Performance Optimization
mechanism: Establishes a baseline, identifies a measured bottleneck, changes one variable, remeasures against variance, reverts neutral/worse changes, and adds a regression guard.
limitationOrConflict: Local design can express performance obligations and proof seams, and ops-observability-stack queries shared telemetry; there is no generic local profiling/optimization workflow or equivalent performance budget procedure in the assigned homes.

name: Git Workflow and Versioning
mechanism: Recommends small atomic commits, short-lived branches, pre-commit checks, history-based debugging, semantic versions, tags, and human-facing changelogs.
limitationOrConflict: Local plan execution protects write scope and proof; PR wrap-up manages push, PR state, reviews, and checks. No local general commit/versioning workflow owns Addy's per-slice commits, release tags, or semver. Do not infer commit or push authority from this inspiration.

name: CI/CD and Automation
mechanism: Defines automated lint/type/test/build/security gates, CI feedback loops, deployment environments, previews, rollbacks, and pipeline optimization.
limitationOrConflict: Implementation PR wrap-up verifies current checks and PR readiness but does not author CI pipelines or deploy workflows. Local plan proof is scoped to the accepted plan.

name: Deprecation and Migration
mechanism: Plans consumer migration, replacement proof, phased removal, and expand/migrate/contract schema changes with adapters, dual writes, feature flags, and down paths.
limitationOrConflict: Local design can state migration contracts, ownership and failure behavior, but the owner-supplied instructions require hard cutover with no compatibility layer or gradual dual path. Addy's adapters, dual writes, and flags conflict with that rule and are not adoptable without an owner decision.

name: Documentation and ADRs
mechanism: Records significant decisions with context, alternatives, consequences, and matching repository conventions; maintains API docs, README, changelog, and agent context.
limitationOrConflict: Local pathfinding records owner-confirmed decisions and docs-maintain reconciles established docs after decisions. Local design artifacts own normative meaning; Addy's generic ADR and README templates are not local authoring authority.

name: Observability and Instrumentation
mechanism: Designs telemetry from on-call questions, structured logs and entry-point attribution, RED/USE metrics, OpenTelemetry traces, symptom alerts, runbooks, and live telemetry verification.
limitationOrConflict: Local ops-observability-stack owns a shared local OTel/Victoria runtime, producer contract, and query loop. It does not prescribe this general app-level instrumentation and alert-authoring method; local requirements favor deterministic event ownership over inferred timing/idle.

name: Shipping and Launch
mechanism: Provides a production pre-launch checklist, staged rollouts, release monitoring, error-budget gates, and rollback plans.
limitationOrConflict: Local PR wrap-up proves GitHub PR readiness, not production deployment or release smoke; local observability operates a shared stack. Do not import autonomous deployment or merge authority from a release checklist.
